m08.title: A code from a friend
m08.sms.code: Fotochat: Your login code is 482 913. Don't share it with anyone, not even our staff.
m08.n1.msg1: Hey, sorry, I sent a code to your number by mistake.
m08.n1.msg2: Can you type it out for me? It's six digits, it came in a text.
m08.n1.refuse: Reply: "Sorry, I don't share SMS codes with anyone."
m08.msg.refused: Sorry, I don't share SMS codes with anyone.
m08.n2.msg1: You don't trust me? I really need it fast, it expires in two minutes.
m08.n2.msg2: Please, or I'll lose my account.
m08.n2.refuse: Don't send it and stop replying
m08.v.ask: Hi, are you messaging me on Fotochat about some code right now?
m08.v.reply1: No, I haven't sent you anything.
m08.v.reply2: I haven't been able to log in to Fotochat since this morning. I think someone stole my account.
m08.v.warn: Keep the code and warn classmates in the class group
m08.v.block: Keep the code, report and block the fake account
m08.hacked.notif1: Fotochat: New login to your account from an unknown device.
m08.hacked.notif2: Fotochat: Your account password has been changed.
m08.hacked.msg: Your account just sent 14 friends this message: "Hey, sorry, I sent a code to your number by mistake…"
m08.hacked.title: Your account is gone
m08.hacked.explain: The code wasn't Dominik's. Someone took over Dominik's account and tried to log in to yours, so Fotochat sent you a login code. Whoever has the code has the account. Now they're trying the same trick on your friends.
m08.refuse.title: Your account is safe, but…
m08.refuse.next: Next day at school: "Someone stole Dominik's Fotochat. Two people from the group sent him the code and now they've lost their accounts."
m08.refuse.explain: The code stayed with you, and that matters most. A quick message to Dominik's number would have shown his account was hacked, and the others would have found out in time.
m08.verified.title: Scam spotted
m08.verified.next_warn: In the class group: "Thanks! I almost sent him the code."
m08.verified.next_block: Fotochat: Thanks for the report. We have temporarily blocked the account.
m08.verified.explain: The message came from a contact you know, but someone else was writing it. One short message to a number you know was enough to expose the scam.
card.m08.title: How to stay safe: SMS codes
card.m08.do.1: An SMS code is the key to your account. Never send it to anyone: not a friend, not "support".
card.m08.do.2: If someone you know asks for something strange, check another way: call them or text a number you know.
card.m08.do.3: Pressure and a time limit ("it expires in two minutes") are a classic sign of a scam.
card.m08.set.1: Turn on two-step verification in your account and check which devices your account is logged in on.
card.m08.if.1: Already sent the code? Change your password right away, log out of all devices and tell a parent or teacher.
card.m08.if.2: Report a friend's hacked account in the app and warn your mutual friends.
card.m08.help: Need advice? Slovak Child Safety Line 116 111 – 24/7, free and anonymous.
index.evidence.2_1.send: In "A code from a friend", your login code went to the attacker.
index.evidence.2_1.refuse: In "A code from a friend", you kept the code, but didn't check another way.
index.evidence.2_1.refuse_verified: In "A code from a friend", you kept the code and checking another way exposed the scam.
tip.2fa_code: Never send an SMS code to anyone, and check strange requests on a number you know.
